Read the repository's `AGENTS.md` before working. Select and read the relevant
repository skills under `.github/skills/` before making changes, and keep those
skills current when a verified change or agent mistake alters their guidance.
The source, tests, and linked user documentation remain authoritative.

Follow `AGENTS.md`'s commit and comment discipline: make small, frequent
commits after independently complete, verified units unless the user asks to
leave work uncommitted. Keep comments precise and thorough about non-obvious
intent, invariants, edge cases, tradeoffs, and side effects; keep them current,
and avoid narrating obvious code.
